cached_path_download: download a URL or S3 file to the local cache and return the cached file path
url_to_filename_hash: convert a URL into a repeatable SHA256 hashed filename optionally including an ETag
filename_to_url_lookup: look up the original URL and ETag stored in metadata for a cached filename
s3_etag_check: check the ETag of an S3 object given its s3:// URL
read_set_from_file: read a text file line by line and return a deduplicated set of strings
